attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family with the per-TU flags in configure.py

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: For a table addressed as base + TABLE_OFF + index*STRIDE + k*4 (base reloaded per statement because stores alias it), cast to a STRIDE-sized struct array: `((T*)(base + TABLE_OFF))[index].f[k]` where sizeof(T) == STRIDE. MWCC then keeps index*STRIDE as one mulli, re-derives base per statement, and folds TABLE_OFF + k*4 into the load displacement: add rD,base,mulli; lfs disp(rD) - matching retail. The offset-cast forms `((V*)(base + index*STRIDE))->field` or `*(f32*)(base + off + CONST)` instead let PRE group (off + CONST) into hoisted addi offset registers feeding lfsx - an indexed-address web that a plain padded view struct does NOT kill.
